upstream_reason: Final public known-regression gate FAIL; this record relies on the root decision and does not independently recalculate prediction results.
interpretation: Do not describe external evaluation as FAIL or PASS: it was not run.

DADA acquisition and independent visual review yielded zero official exact ground-truth labels; six conditional origin-side references and five broad entry intervals support only a predeclared falsification filter.
Obtaining additional footage did not resolve the lack of precise task-aligned labels or establish generalization performance.

Excluding changes that fail the predeclared public gate and restoring a comparator with less observed regression are evidence-based risk control; restoration is not a demonstrated new performance improvement.
The frozen external gate must not be relaxed or used post hoc to rescue the rejected candidate.
